methodology: Current 2026-2027 official catalog authority controls over stale college marketing links and archived catalog records.
A general transfer award is included only when a current official college source expressly identifies Computer Science as an intended receiving major and links the current award requirements.
Curriculum tables are used as the official requirement inventory; semester placement is discarded rather than treated as a prospective schedule.
No Computer Science coursework is inferred where the source delegates elective selection to the student, advisor, and receiving institution.

evidence: The current program index lists Business Administration and Engineering in its College & University Transfer Associate of Science section and a generic Science A.S. under Science, Math & Engineering; it does not list the former Science - Computer Science Specialization.
The current Computer & Information Technology section offers applied degrees, certificates, and career studies certificates, not a Computer Science transfer associate award.

The college's public Transfer Programs page still prints Science - Computer Science Specialization, but its anchor targets archived catoid 4 / poid 450. That requested URL now redirects to the current catoid 7 catalog landing page instead of a current program record.

The current generic Science A.S. (poid 702) defines medical or other science-related transfer use and does not define a Computer Science pathway. It is retained only as an alternate non-CS-specific award.

degree.title: Associate of Science in Science
degree.computer_science_relationship: RCC's current Transfer Programs page expressly lists Computer Science as an intended baccalaureate major for the general Science A.S. and links the current poid 695 program.
degree.computer_science_coursework: No CSC course or CS-specific option subset is prescribed. Six general approved-transfer-elective rows totaling 18-19 credits must be selected for the receiving degree with an advisor.

source_semantics.semantic_closure: 42-43 fixed, science, math, and breadth credits plus 18-19 advisor-selected approved-transfer-elective credits equals 60-62.
source_semantics.laboratory_science: One four-credit UCGS lab slot and one distinct four-credit approved-transfer lab-science slot; both complete current menus are retained.
source_semantics.mathematics: Two printed rows totaling 6-7 credits are retained with the footnote's quantitative/statistics and calculus routes and MTH 167 exclusion; they are not flattened into independent choices.
source_semantics.approved_transfer_electives: All 123 courses in the current roster are retained with credit values. One- and two-credit courses may require combinations to fill a printed three-credit row.
source_semantics.breadth: All six current footnote menus are retained exactly, with no duplicate credit across separately printed rows.
